blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) continued to shadow a Chinese research vessel and its coast guards off the outer limit of the Philippine Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) in the Luzon Strait. The PCG said late Friday that China’s Jia Hai Ke 7 had moved north from its earlier position. Two China Coast Guard (CCG) were reportedly sent to escort the research vessel toward the outer EEZ. “A government law enforcement fleet does not escort a commercial survey ship unless that ship’s mission serves the interests of the state,” the PCG asserted in a statement released late Friday.
